UVA PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointments by the Governor of Uva Province
1A

BY virtue of powers vested to me by Section 32 (1) of the Provincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1987, I, M. P. Jayasinghe, Governorof Uva Province do hereby notify that the following appointments have been approved by me.

01.Mr. K. A. B. Senevirathne, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Engineering Service, to act as Deputy Chief Secretary(Engineering Service) for the Uva Provincial Council, in addition to his permanent post, with effect from the date09.12.2014.
02.Mr. R. M. Piyadasa Rathnayake, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Educational Administrative Service, As Director toEducation for the Uva Province, with effect from the date 01.07.2010.
03.Mr. M M. Wijenayake, Grade III Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to act as Provincial Commissioner ofLocal Government of Uva Province, on full time basis from the date 02.02.2015.

04.Mrs. M. E. Sumithra Silva, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Accountancy Service, to act as Deputy Chief Secretary(Finance) for the Uva Provincial Council, on full time basis with effect from the date 28.01.2015.

05.Mrs. R. M. S. D. Rathnayake, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to perform the Duties of theDeputy Chief Secretary (Personnel & Training) for the Uva Provincial Council, from the date 28.02.2015 to 15.03.2015,till the return of Mrs. G. W. C. S. Priyabhashini, to the Island who is the, Deputy Chief Secretary (Personnel & Training)for the Uva Provincial Council.

06.Mrs. Y. Kalai Arasi, Grade II Officer of the Sri Lanka Educational Administrative Service, to act as Additional EducationDirector (Tamil Medium Education) in Tamil Medium Education Unit of the Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs,Textiles and Small Industries & Estate Infrastructure Development and Estate Education for the Uva ProvincialCouncil, on full time basis, with effect from the date 17.03.2015.

07.Mr. W. V. P. Nandapala, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Accountancy Service, as Director to Accounts & Payments forthe Uva Provincial Council, with immediate effect from the date 08.04.2015.

08.Mr. A. A. P. S. K. Karunarathne, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Engineering Service, to act as Deputy Chief Secretary(Engineering Service) for the Uva Provincial Council, on full time basis, with effect from the date 16.04.2015.
09.Mr. A. A. P. S. K. Karunarathne, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Engineering Service, to act as Director (Building) forthe Uva Provincial Council, with effect from the date 16.04.2015.
10.Mrs. S. Ranasinghe, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, as Provincial Commissioner of LocalGovernment of Uva Province, from the date 06.05.2015.

11.Mr. Sumith Suraweera, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to act as Deputy Chief Secretary(Personnel & Training) for the Uva Provincial Council with effect from the date 01.05.2015.

12.Mrs. J. W. C. S. Priyabhashini, Grade III Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to act as Commissioner ofProbation & Childcare service of Uva Province with effect from the date 01.05.2015.

13.Mrs. R. M. S. D. Rathnayake, Grade I Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to act as Deputy Chief Secretary(Administration) for the Uva Provincial Council, on full time basis with effect from the date 15.10.2014.

14.Mr. W. Randeniya, Class III Officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to perform the duties of the MunicipalCommissioner of Badulla Municipal Council, with immediate effect from the date 17.11.2014.
M. P. JAYASINGHE,Governor of Uva Province.
Office of the Uva Governor,18th May, 2015.
